ppes: A (the letter, sounded as in father)

elements.str: (Words of the celestial class in the Hebrew Word are characterized by the vowels U (oo) and O, and to some extent by A.)
The vowels A, 0, and U (oo) are used in the third Heaven because they give a full sound.
The house of Aaron
= good of love.
. Illustrated.
The Levites were given to Aaron because Aaron = the Lord as to the priesthood, that is, as to Divine Love.
Aaron at heart worshipped an Egyptian idol.
Aaron
= the law Divine as to truth;
Moses,
as to good.
Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother?

= doctrine of what is good and true. For Aaron represents the Lord as to Divine good or the priesthood; here, however, before he had been initiated into the priesthood, he is the doctrine of what is good and true, wherefore it is said that he was
for a mouth
to Moses, and Moses was
for a god

to him. For by Moses is represented the Lord as to Divine truth that proceeds immediately from Him; hence by Aaron [is represented]. Divine truth that proceeds mediately from the Lord, which truth is the doctrine of what is good and true. The truth that Moses here represents is that which cannot be heard or perceived by man, but the truth that Aaron represents is that which can be heard and perceived by man. Hence Aaron is called
the mouth,
and Moses his
god.
Hence also Aaron is called
the Levite,
for
Levite
= the church's doctrine of what is good and true, which ministers to and serves the priesthood.
And Jehovah said to Aaron
= the truth of doctrine, and perception therein from the Divine.
And Moses told
Aaron
= influx of truth that proceeds immediately from the Lord's Divine into truth that proceeds mediately.
And Aaron spake all the words that Jehovah spake to Moses
= doctrine thence from the Divine.
And afterwards came Moses and Aaron

= the Divine law and doctrine thence... By the Divine law that Moses represents is understood the Word such as it is in its inward sense, thus such as it is in the Heavens; but by doctrine is understood the Word such as it is in its literal sense, thus such as it is on earth. Explained.
Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron, draw away the people from their works?
= that their Divine law and doctrine will not release them from troubles.
Moses
= the Lord as to Divine law, and
Aaron
= the Lord as to doctrine thence.
Aaron and his families represent those things that belong to doctrine.
And Jehovah spake to Moses and to Aaron
= instruction anew from the law Divine and at the same time from doctrine.
Aaron took to himself Elisheba... for a woman
= doctrine of the Church, and how good and truth are therein conjoined.
Aaron
= what is outward of the Spiritual Church, and
Moses,
what is inward. Explained.
This Moses and Aaron
= that this was from the law, that is from the Divine, and from doctrine thence.
And Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet
= doctrine thence, (i.e., from the law Divine.)
And Aaron [was] a son of three and eighty years
= the state and quality of doctrine.
Say to Aaron
= influx of inward law into outward law. The doctrine of what is good and true that Aaron represents is nothing but outward law existing from inward law, that is, through inward law from the Divine.
Inward law that Moses represents is truth accommodated to Angels, and outward law, that Aaron represents is truth accommodated to men. Explained.
And Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron
= presence of law Divine... Moses represents inward, and Aaron outward law.
And Jehovah said to Moses and to Aaron
= instruction anew... Truth that proceeds from Jehovah is represented by Moses and Aaron, inward truth by Moses, and outward by Aaron.
And Moses and Aaron returned unto Pharaoh
= presence of truth Divine thence.
Jehovah said to Moses and Aaron
= information through truth Divine... Moses represents truth proceeding from the Divine immediately; Aaron, mediately.
(They murmured) against Moses and against Aaron
= [against] truth Divine. Moses represents truth Divine proceeding from the Lord immediately, thus inward; and Aaron, truth from the Lord proceeding mediately, thus outward.
And Moses said unto Aaron
= influx of truth Divine proceeding immediately from the Lord through truth Divine that [proceeds] mediately.
Aaron spake to all the company of Israel
= instruction from the Divine through influx, (i.e.) from the Divine through truth proceeding from the Lord mediately, which is represented by Aaron.
In the inward historical sense, Moses and Aaron do not represent truth Divine, but the religiosity of that nation whose leaders and heads they were.
Moses, Aaron, and Hur
= Divine truths in successive order.
Moses
= Divine truth proceeding immediately;
Aaron,
Divine truth proceeding mediately; and
Hur,
Divine truth proceeding mediately through that again.
And Aaron came and all the elders of Israel
= things of the church that are primary. Aaron represents truth of doctrine.
They who are intermediate between the celestial and spiritual kingdoms were represented by Moses and Aaron, who were permitted to go up the mountain.
Come up thou and Aaron
= conjunction with truth from the Divine, inward and outward.
Aaron and his sons, who filled the office of the high-priesthood, represent the Lord.
Thou and Aaron

= the Word in the inward and outward sense. Moses represents the Word; and when Aaron, who was his brother, is joined to him, Moses then represents the Word in the inward sense, and Aaron in the outward.
And there went up Moses and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu
= the Word in the inward and outward sense, and doctrine from both.
Behold Aaron and Hur with ye

(the elders) = doctrine of truth from such a Word. Aaron here represents doctrine of truth from the outward sense of the Word alone, because, by the elders, over whom Aaron was set as a head below the mountain, were signified those who are in the outward sense of the Word.

The doctrine here represented by Aaron and Hur, being from the outward sense of the Word alone, without the inward sense, was merely idolatrous; wherefore it is said of Aaron, by whom such doctrine was represented, that he made an idol, or
golden calf.
By Aaron as high-priest was represented the Lord as to good of love; and by his garments, especially by the ephod, was represented truth of faith that is from good of love.

That man is heard and his worship received when he has been cleansed from evils, was represented by Aaron's not entering into the holy place within the veil until he had expiated himself and the people.
The priestly office that Aaron filled, represents the Lord as to Divine good.
The process of the glorification of the Lord's Human even to Divine good, is described in the inward sense, and was exhibited before the Angels, when Aaron went through these [initiatory rites].
After these had been gone through, Aaron represented the Lord as to Divine good.
Aaron and his sons shall set it in order
= perpetual influx from the Lord... By Aaron was represented the Lord as to Divine good, and by his sons, as to Divine truth.
And thou, make to draw nigh unto thee Aaron thy brother
= conjunction of Divine truth with Divine good in the Lord's Divine Human. Moses... represents the Lord as to Divine truth, ... Aaron, as to Divine good.
Aaron was chosen to fill the priestly office because he was the brother of Moses, for thus there was simultaneously represented the brotherhood of Divine truth and also of Divine good in Heaven.
Aaron
= a representative of the Lord as to the Divine Celestial, ... which is the Divine of the Lord in the inmost Heaven.
Sons of Aaron
= the things that proceed from the Divine Celestial.
And Aaron shall carry the names of the sons of Israel
= the preservation by the Lord of good and truth as to every quality... Aaron represents the Lord as to Divine good.
And it shall be upon Aaron
= a representative of the Lord. Aaron here represents the Lord as to those things that concern evangelization and worship.
By Aaron was represented the Lord, and by his office, all the work of salvation; and on man's part, worship.
And it shall be upon the forehead of Aaron
= from the Divine love of the Lord. Aaron represents the Lord as to Divine good, which is the good of his Divine love.
And Aaron shall carry the iniquity of the holy ones
= removal thereby (i.e. by the Divine love) of falsities and evils with those who are in good from the Lord. Aaron represents the Lord as to good of love.
And it shall be upon the forehead of Aaron constantly
= a representative of the Lord's love for ever... Aaron represents the Lord.
For the sons of Aaron

= Divine truths proceeding from the Divine good of the Lord in the Heavens. It is said in the Heavens, because it is the Divine of the Lord in the Heavens that was represented by the priestly office of Aaron and his sons; Divine good in the Heavens, by the priestly office of Aaron, and Divine truth from Divine good there, by that of his sons. Explained.
And thou shalt put them on Aaron thy brother

= such a state of Divine good in the spiritual kingdom... By Aaron was represented the Lord as to Divine good, thus also Divine good that is from the Lord; and by his garments, the Lord's spiritual kingdom joined to His celestial kingdom.

Aaron in his garments represented the Lord as to Divine good in the Heavens, Aaron himself, the Lord as to the Divine celestial there, and his garments, as to the Divine spiritual there, proceeding from the Divine celestial.
In the inward sense of this chapter the glorification of the Lord as to the Human is treated of, which is signified by the inauguration of Aaron and his sons into the priestly office.

The priestly office that is represented by Aaron is the work of the salvation of those who are in the Lord's celestial kingdom, ... but the priestly office represented by the sons of Aaron is the work of the salvation of those who are in the Lord's spiritual kingdom most closely proceeding from His celestial kingdom.
And thou shalt sprinkle upon Aaron, and upon his garments

= reciprocal unition of Divine good and Divine truth in the higher Heavens. Aaron represents the Lord as to Divine good, which is the Divine good of the Lord in the celestial kingdom, or, what is the same, in the higher Heavens; and the garments of Aaron are a representative of the Lord's spiritual kingdom joined to His celestial kingdom.
And thou shalt put all things upon the palms of Aaron, and upon the palms of his sons
= acknowledgement in the Heavens that those things are of the Lord and from the Lord... Aaron and his sons represent the Lord as to Divine good and Divine truth thence proceeding.
And thou shalt do to Aaron and to his sons thus

= this representative of the Lord's glorification, and His influx into the Heavens and into the Church. Aaron represents the Lord as to Divine good, and his sons, the Lord as to Divine good spiritual.
And Aaron shall [burn] incense upon it
= the elevation by the Lord of worship that is from love and charity... Aaron as high-priest represents the Lord as to Divine good, and as to the work of salvation.
And Aaron and his sons shall wash out of it
= a representative of the purification and regeneration of man by the Lord... Aaron represents the Lord as to Divine good celestial, and the sons of Aaron, the Lord as to Divine good spiritual.
Since the Lord is understood by Aaron in a representative sense, therefore by
the seed of Aaron
are specifically understood those who are in the Lord's Celestial Kingdom, and also by
their generations,
those who are in His Spiritual Kingdom.
And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons
= inauguration to represent the Lord in both kingdoms.
And the people was gathered together to Aaron

= that it betook itself to the outward things of the Word, of the Church and of worship, separated from what is inward... The reason why this is here represented by Aaron, is that he was the head of that nation in the absence of Moses. Explained in
And Moses said to Aaron
= perception from what is internal about such an external.
Because Aaron had made it (the people) dissolute
= that this [will be done] by the outward things that they will love... Aaron represents what is outward.
And Aaron and all the sons of Israel saw Moses
= the perception
of those who are in the outward things of the Church, of worship and of the Word, without inward things.
And Aaron and all the princes in the assembly turned back to him
= the principal ones who are in outward things, and yet might represent inward things.
In the Word in Heaven for
Aaron
there is
priesthood,
and for
David,
royalty,
both of the Lord.
Why a bridegroom there is dressed like Aaron.
Abaddon
is perdition.
They had a king over them, the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name is Abaddon or Apollyon
= that their falsities were from Hell, where they are merely natural and in their own intelligence.
Abaddon
in the Hebrew signifies one who destroys, and the destroyer; in like manner
Apollyon
in the Greek. Illustrated.
I called them Abaddons or Apollyons.
Such are called Abaddon or Apollyon, that is, the destroyer.
Abaddon and Apollyon = the destroyer of the Church by falsities.
Breathing then receded more towards the abdomen.
When such spirits are present they induce a sensible anxiety in the part of the abdomen immediately below the diaphragm.
. See also
The inhabitants of the moon speak from air collected in the abdomen. See also
Chastising spirits induce a pain in the region of the abdomen of the inhabitants of that earth who think and do evilly.
(The contraction of the abdomen that is caused by a sad state of mind.)
When the popes sit in the consistory they feel something creeping and turning about in the abdomen when anyone else says what is approved of.
The anxiety of very deceitful spirits caused a pain in the region of the abdomen.
Abel
= charity, which is love towards the neighbour.
The offering of Abel
= the worship of charity.
Cain killing Abel his brother
= the extinction of charity with those who separate faith and set it before charity.
Jehovah had respect to Abel and to his offering
= that all things of charity and of its worship were pleasing to the Lord.
The blood of Abel
= the extinction of charity.
Righteous Abel
= those who are in good of charity.
Abel
= celestial love, or what is the same, good conjoined with truth.
The month Abib
= the beginning from which are all the following states.
The month Abib
= the beginning of a new state.
Abib,
being the first month of the year = the beginning of a new state.
Abimelech the king of Gerar
= the doctrine of faith.
Abimelech
= the doctrine of faith looking to rational things.
, Explained in
Abimelech
= doctrine looking to rational things, or what is the same, the rational things of doctrine.
The house of Abimelech
= the good of the doctrine of faith.
Abimelech and Phicol
= human rational things from scientifics.
Abraham gave flock and herd to Abimelech
= Divine goods implanted in rational things of doctrine.
Abimelech and Phicol returned to the land of the Philistines
= that still they had no part in doctrine.
They who are being regenerated and are becoming men of the Spiritual Church are meant by
Abimelech,
that is, they who are in the doctrine of faith, and have regard to truths in knowledges.
(In the highest sense
Abimelech
represents the Lord as to doctrine that has regard to rational things.)
Abimelech,
as king of the Philistines, = doctrine without life.
Abimelech, Ahusath and Phicol

= those who are in the literal sense of the Word, and thence in the doctrinal things of faith... These are they who make faith the essential thing, and do not indeed reject charity, but postpone it, thus set doctrine before life...
In the good of truth are they who are here represented by
Abimelech.
Explained.
These spirits are represented by
Abimelech.
Abimelech
king of Gerar or of the Philistines = those who place salvation in mere truths without good of life.
Spirits who supposed they were able to do all things.
The man who is alienated from good and truth intends nothing but evil, for he is not able to intend what is good.
The infernals are not able to do what is good, because it is repugnant to them.
There is in man the ability to love, although he does not exercise it...
Ability in itself is Divine. Explained.
For all ability there must be opportunity.
The Posse and Velle of God are one. Explained.
It is said they are not able, because the inward will of their mind is adverse.
When a spirit confesses that he is not able to desist from evil he is vastated until he is able...
. See
They said they could not by any possibility desist...
The abodes of the evil there.
The angelic abodes shine like the stars. Illustrated.
The inhabitants of Jupiter call the starry heaven the abode of the Angels.
The evil there introduce themselves into the abodes of the good.
This inmost degree is the Lord's very abode with man...
Since Angels are men they have abodes, etc.
On abodes... The abodes of my mothers there.
The mansions
in the ark = the two parts of man, which are the will and the understanding.
The heavenly societies are called by the Lord
mansions.
I was led through some of the mansions of the first Heaven...
Souls recently from the world are taken by the Angels round many mansions, which are separate Societies...
I also have been led through mansions...
They turned in to him
= abode.
Where there is an abode of the intelligent and wise, chariots and horses continually appear.
Hence there are so many Heavens, which in the Word are called
mansions.
There are many who have abodes under the soles of the feet...
We will make our abode with him
= to dwell in his good.
To have an abode with those of the Spiritual Church. Signified.
The abode of the Lord with man is in the good that is in him.
King's houses
= the abodes where the Angels are, and in the universal sense, Heaven.
Windows according to the number of mansions or chambers...
On the habitations and mansions of the Angels. General article.
Hence it is that the angelic abodes are indeed in Heaven and to the sight are separate from the abodes where men are, but still they are with man in his affections of good and truth. Illustrated.
(Comparison made with a column divided into three degrees or stories.)
These two faculties are the Lord's abode in the human race... But the Lord's abode is closer with a man in proportion as the man opens the higher degrees by means of these faculties.
An abode is given them.
Stairs from story to story.
The human mind is like the three stories of a house.
. Explained.
The Lord then makes His abode with him.
The rooms of that house that are underground.
That they who are elevated from the Lower Earth into... Heaven have mansions most exactly allotted to them. General article.
The celestials who are in some mansion are at once able to feel and perceive whether it agrees with their character... and also in what place of the mansion... they can have consociation.

That they who are led to their mansions seem to be carried about... They suppose themselves to be borne in a chariot, and so to be carried about as it were through labyrinthine ways, backwards and forwards, in order that they may come to the mansion where are they who have almost the same character.
That those who have not come so recently from the bodily life can be admitted into the mansions of a more inward Heaven, yet in another way.
On mansions. (Of doves, etc.)
Cupidities and falsities cannot be abolished in a moment...
Not a single evil or falsity is so dispersed as to be abolished...
Why the Lord abolished representatives?
On the former heaven and its abolition. General article.
Falsities and evils in man are not abolished, but removed, and when removed they appear to be abolished. Signified.
Sins are not abolished, but removed...
Abominable
= filthy cupidities.
Evils are then regarded as abominable.
The abomination of desolation
= the state of the Church when there is no love and charity, for then abominable things reign.
The abomination of desolation
= the vastation of the Church. Explained.
An abomination to the Egyptians
= that they are in what is opposite. Explained.
The abomination of the Egyptians
= the separation of scientifics. Explained.
Nothing is more abominable there than profaned truth...
Abomination
= infernal noisomeness and defilement.
Hence it is that adulteries are so wicked, and are called abominations.
Still more has he religion who abominates them (adulteries).
At last he abominates it.
He who abominates them as so many dusky and burning devils...
Abominations
= profanations of what is holy.
et seq
. Described.
The abominable
= those who are in all kinds of evils, for
abominations
in general = the evils named in the last six commandments. Illustrated.
To
work abomination
= to do evils, for
abominations
= evils of every kind, especially those named in the decalogue.
The abomination of desolation
= the falsification and deprivation of all truth.
Hence is the
abomination of desolation.
General article. See
These abominations (Arianism and Socinianism).
Four wicked abominations at once are thus committed. Enumerated.
The abomination of devastation
= the devastation of the Church, which is effected when there is no longer any truth or faith, because no good or charity.
Abominations from between the teeth
= adulterations of the knowledges of good.
Abomination before Jehovah
= every evil against the Divine itself.
An abominable branch
= truth falsified.
The bird of abominations
= faith alone. Explained.
Abominations
= profanations of good. Defined. Explained.
On the abomination of desolation. General article. See also
., the Preface to Invitation to the New Church.

These Satanic spirits are called the abomination of desolation because they are all in falsities as to faith and in evils as to life; the inner things of their minds are infernal, and the outer things are as it were heavenly by virtue of feigned morality.
The abomination of desolation on earth also. Representation.
There shall not be one aborting or barren in the land
= that goods and truths shall proceed in their order in continuous progression. Explained, Illustrated.
What belongs to abortion and sterility in the spiritual sense is perversions of good and truth, also the vastations and denials of them. Illustrated.
The flocks and herds miscarried.
Spirits above the head.
The inward man is above the rational.
Divine things are above the understanding of human rational truth.
What is Divine is above all understanding and thought...
. Explained.
Although it seems to him that he is rational above all others.
That is below to the infernals which to the celestials is above, and that is above to the infernals which to the celestials is below.
What is spiritual and celestial is within or above nature.
To
set over
= dominion.
Over
= serving and ministering.
Such persons place blessedness in being over the Angels.
To elevate themselves above others...
The Divine truth that proceeds immediately is above all angelic understanding.
The first two degrees of Divine Truth are above the Heavens.
Man is so created that he can look upwards, or above himself, and also downwards, or below himself. Explained.
Hence it is that Heaven appears above, and Hell below.
Everything inward is there presented to view representatively as above, and what is outward as below. References.
The Divine regarded in itself is above the Heavens...
The Divine above the Heavens is Divine Good itself.
Their inward man is closed above and open below. See
Above
= within.
, Explained.
, Explained.
The Lord Himself is above the Heavens... His Divine above the Heavens cannot be represented, because it is infinite...
If the higher things of the mind are closed above...
The Lord appears above Heaven as a sun, but the truth is He is in it...
The Lord being above the Heavens as a sun does not speak to the Angels thence, but flows in.
These ancient Heavens are above the Christian Heaven.
This limbus is below with those who come into Heaven and what is spiritual is above, but with those who come into Hell the limbus is above and what is spiritual below.
They who are above see and perceive all things below, but they who are below perceive and see nothing of the things above, that is, within.
That they who are above give light to those who are below, when they agree.
The Church signified by
Noah
continued to the time of Abram.
Abraham
represented saving faith.
The first style of the Word is used up to the time of Abram... The historical style is used from the time of Abram.
Abraham
represented celestial love,
Isaac,
spiritual love; these are of the inward man;
Jacob
represented the same, but of the outward man. Illustrated.
Since
Abram
represented love or saving faith,
his seed
means all in the universe who are in love. Illustrated.
Celestial love represented by
Abraham
is as the father of spiritual love represented by
Isaac,
for the spiritual is born from the celestial.
Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
mean all who are in love.
Because
Abraham
represented the celestial things of faith, he sojourned in the land of the Philistines, and entered into a covenant with them.
Abram,
Nahor,
and
Haran
were persons, from whom nations also were named that were idolaters.
, Explained.
Abram was an idolater and knew not Jehovah.
Abram, Nahor and Haran,
as nations, = idolatrous worships.

In consequence of being idolaters, and not knowing Jehovah, or what is the good and truth of faith, Terah and Abram were better fitted to receive the seed of truth than others in Syria with whom knowledges still remained...
Abram and Nahor took wives; the name of Abram's wife was Sarai
= the marriages of evil with falsity in idolatrous worship.
Terah took Abram his son, and Lot... and went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees to go into the Land of Canaan; and they came even to Haran, and remained there
= that those who were in idolatrous worship were instructed in celestial and spiritual things of faith, in order that a representative Church might exist therefrom.
Terah died in Haran
= the end of idolatry and the beginning of a representative Church by Abram.
What is said in this chapter about Abram represents the Lord's state from earliest childhood to adolescence.
What is said about the sojourn of Abram in Egypt = the Lord's first instruction.
Abram,
in general, represents the Lord; specifically, the celestial man.
Abram
represents the Lord.
The Representative Church began with Abram.
Abram
represents the Lord, and therefore also the celestial man; Isaac, the Lord and thence the spiritual man, and Jacob the Lord and thence the natural man corresponding to the spiritual.
Jehovah said to Abram
= the very first act of taking notice.
The land of his birth, from which Abram went out, was idolatrous.
By Abram is represented the Lord as to His human essence; afterwards as to both the human and the Divine essence, and then he is called Abraham.
Abram took Sarai his wife
= good to which truth was adjoined. Explained.
Abram
here means the Lord when He was a child.
Abram went through the land to the place Shechem
= the Lord's second state. Explained.
Jehovah seen by Abram
= that Jehovah appeared to the Lord when as yet a child.
And Abram went down to sojourn in Egypt
= instruction in knowledges from the Word.
. Illustrated.
Pharaoh treated Abram well for her sake
= that scientifics were multiplied with the Lord.
And Pharaoh called Abram
= that the Lord remembered.
The Lord's outward man or human essence is represented in this chapter by
Lot,
and His inward man or Divine essence, by
Abram.
Abram went up from Egypt
= from scientifics, which left the Lord.
Abram
= what was celestial in the Lord, thus
he and his wife
= the celestial truths then in the Lord.
Abram was very heavy
with
cattle,
silver
and
gold
= the goods, truths, and goods from truths with which the Lord was then enriched.
Lot going with Abram
= the outward man that was with the Lord.
Signification of the separation of Lot from Abram.
A dispute between the shepherds of Abram's cattle, and the shepherds of Lot's cattle
= that the inward man and the outward man did not agree.
And Abram said unto Lot
= thus said the inward man to the outward... Abram represents the inward man relatively to Lot, who is that in the outward man which is to be separated.
The things that agree are
Abram,
even those in the outward man, for these constitute one thing with the inward man, and belong to it.
Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan
= that the inward man was in the celestial things of love.
Jehovah said to Abram
= that Jehovah thus spake to the Lord.
Abram pitched his tent and came and dwelt in the oak grove Mamre, which is in Hebron
= that the Lord came to a still more inward perception.
Abram the Hebrew
= the rational man.
Abram the Hebrew
= the interior man to which the inward or Divine man is adjoined.
Why Abram is here called
the Hebrew.
Abram heard that his brother was made captive
= the interior man perceived in what kind of state the outward man was.
Abram
here = the inward man in the interior or middle man.
(Abram) = the rational man. Explained.
Abram blessed God Most High
= that the Lord's interior or rational man had enjoyment of goods from His inward man.
Abram
= the Lord's rational.
In the two preceding chapters
Abram
represented the Lord and His state in childhood; in this chapter he represents the Lord's rational, and is then called
Abram the Hebrew
. No other Abram is understood in this chapter than
Abram the Hebrew.
The Spiritual of the Lord that was adjoined to the inward man is
Abram the Hebrew,
but the Celestial is represented by Melchizedek.
Abram here represents the Lord now a conqueror.
Lest thou shouldst say, I have enriched Abram
= that hence the Lord derived no strength.
After these words the word of Jehovah came to Abram in vision
= that after combats in childhood there was revelation.
Abram said, O Lord Jehovih
= the Lord's perception;
Abram
is the interior man,
Lord Jehovih,
the inward relatively to the interior man.
Abram said, Lo to me Thou hast not given seed
= that there was nothing inward of the Church.
Abraham is not known in Heaven.
Abram drove them away
= the Lord put them to flight.
Sleep fell upon Abram
= that the Church was then in falsities.
Jehovah made a covenant with Abram
= the conjunction of the Lord's interior with His inward man.
The seed of Abram
= love and faith thence, thus all who are in charity and faith in the Lord.
In this chapter
Abram
is the inward man of the Lord, who is Jehovah.
Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
represent the inward, the rational, and the natural man.
, Explained.
Abram said to Sarai
= perception. The Lord's perception is signified by
Abram said to Sarai,
but thought from perception by
Sarai said to Abram.
Abram was a son of eighty years and six years
= the Lord's state as to celestial goods acquired through the combats of temptations.
Hence it is that
Abram

The concordant action of man with the action of the Lord is what is here understood by cooperation.

Action and cooperation such as have been described, may be seen in everything that is in any activity and mobility; such is the action and cooperation of the heart and all its arteries; the heart acts, and the arteries cooperate... Other examples given.
The Lord alone acts, and man suffers himself to be acted upon, and cooperates to all appearance as from himself, although inwardly from God.
Hence it is that from a single action of man the Angels perceive the quality of his will...
As will is in action...
Wherefore all things that proceed from man, whether action or conversation, make the man, and are the man himself.
On the multitude of Spirits who concur to one single action of man.
In order to appropriation and conjunction there must be action and reaction. Explained.
Nothing can act or move unless it is between two forces, of which one acts and the other reacts.
Hence it is that the will and the act are one.
3. Hence love acts and wisdom reacts, and by this reciprocality every effect exists.
No happiness of life without active life.
. Explained.
Praising the Lord is not such active life, but is an effect of that life.

In the simplest organic [forms] of man there is a passive and an active, and unless these were coupled as it were in a marriage like that of man and wife, they could not be there, still less produce anything. In like manner in universal nature.
Diverse activities of forces and motions in the body.
Man's inward [substances] are in a certain unknown activity... the activity of this sphere extends itself...

The activity (of that celestial state) is thus described. Worship itself is nothing but a certain activity existing from the celestial within; the celestial itself can never be without activity; worship is the first activity... all good of love and of charity is the essential activity itself.
The rational in itself is nothing unless affection flows into it and makes it active...
Since they correspond to each other, as active and passive, it is called correspondence.

Delight from good and pleasantness from truth, which constitute blessedness in Heaven, do not consist in idleness but in activity... Delight and pleasantness endure permanently, and are continually elevated in activity, and constitute blessedness. Activity with those in Heaven consists in performing uses...
The reason why the Angels are His ministries is that they may be in active life, and thence in happiness.
Man's thought is active and passive. Explained.
The mouth of man
= active, or speaking thought.
. Explained.
Active thought is the speech of man's spirit.
In order to the production of anything, there must be two forces, one called active and the other passive...
Desire is the activity itself of life...
Power, which is the activity of life.
The activity of the whole body is brought together in the arms and hands...
Moral and civil life is the activity of spiritual life. Explained.
Forms are substances, forces are their activities...
Activities and motions.
They excite the atmospheres to their activities.
Prior things continually decrease in activity and expansion even to ultimates; when their activity and expansion cease in ultimates...
That love or the will is thus in its sensitive, and in its active life. General article.
Activity in man corresponds to the Divine proceeding in the Lord.
All activity proceeds from the soul through the body.
The idea that the inward activity of nature is life.
The activity of love produces the sense of delight, its activity in Heaven is with wisdom, and its activity in Hell is with insanity.
This influx of love and wisdom is the activity itself from which is all the delight that is called Good.

Both an active and a passive are necessary to every operation; it is the same with the spiritual and the natural, the spiritual, being a living force, is active, and the natural, being a dead force, is passive.
Attributes all activity to the Lord.
Man's activity does not proceed from the soul through the body, but out of the body from the soul.
Life is the inmost activity of the love and wisdom that are in God, and are God...
Activity itself, regarded in itself, is not creatable... Sound, which is the activity of the atmosphere, is not creatable; neither is heat, which is the primary activity...
It is from creation that where there are actives there are also passives; if the actives were creatable, like the passives, there would have been no need of a sun...
The (natural) sun consists of created substances the activity of which produces fire.
Under
, see this reference.
The actives of life are called celestial things, and the passives, spiritual things...
That no effect can exist in the universe without an active and a passive, thus without a marriage...
Only an active life has joy in it, and it is life because it is active. See also

In order to appropriation there must be an active and a reactive, the active is from the Lord, and also the reactive, but this appears as if it were from man, for the Lord Himself gives this reactive.
All activities are changes of state and variations of form.
Men of activity
= those who excel in doctrine;
activity
= what excels.
Men of activity
= those who have powers
from
the
truths
that
are
from
good.
Activity
= powers, because, in the Hebrew, powers are meant by the same term as activity.
Men of activity
= truths with which good can be conjoined.
Briskness or activity one of the moral virtues.
Like an actor in a theatre.
Actors and acting in Heaven. Explained.
Such appear to those in Heaven like stage players.
He who commits actual sin induces upon himself a nature thence.
Every man is able to be perfected... according to the actualities of his life.
Man draws with him into the other life, from actual sins, innumerable evils and falsities.
No one is punished there for hereditary evil, but for the actual evils that he has himself committed.
With the Lord there was no actual or proper evil.
Hell consists of hatreds, not of those which man has got hereditarily, but of those he has acquired by actual life.
Evil spirits and Genii are only allowed to operate into those things which a man has actually acquired...
The things on the earth do not exist ideally, but actually.
The actual [life] of parents, confirmed by habit, puts on a nature and is implanted hereditarily in the infants.
The nature itself that he has contracted by actual life in the world remains...
The other origin of evils with a man is from what is actual... but this actual evil has also various origins, in general two. Signified, Explained.
The evil a man has contracted by actual life and confirmed in thought even to faith and persuasion, cannot be amended, but remains for ever.
Earrings in their ears
= actual things. Explained.
Truth then changes its essence and becomes actual (i.e. good).
Son and daughter
= the things that are proper to man from actuality.
The actuality of the appropriation of truth. Signified.
But still he is not actually in anything of intelligence and wisdom unless he removes the loves of self and of the world.
The interiors are actually elevated, and are then actually withdrawn from the body and the world... and come then actually into Heaven.
. [Swedenborg footnote 1.]
The understanding actually acts as one with the will...
The conjunction of husband and wife is an actual conjunction. Explained.
Man superadds to his hereditary evils new ones from himself, which are called actual evils.
Sins can only be taken away by actual repentance.
What is actually the first effect of life...
But when they heard that the Divine is actually in everything...
In nothing no actuality of mind is possible.
The actuality of the natural sun is not from itself...
Such forces are the atmospheres as to actualities.
What is life according to His commandments but actual acknowledgement that salvation is from Him?
Times and spaces in the spiritual world exist not actually, but still apparently.
As to his spirit he is then actually with Angels in Heaven... He is then as to his spirit actually with devils in Hell.
In order that He might actually become a man...
Works are essentially of the will, formally of the understanding, and actually of the body.
Fruits are essentially of the seed, formally of the leaves and flowers, and actually of the wood of the tree.
No one is judged after death from any hereditary evil, but from the actual ones that he has himself committed. Signified.
Actual repentance defined. General article.
. Explained.
Repentance is to be performed actually. Defined.
This will suffice to initiate him into actuality.
That actual repentance is easy to those who... General article.
He who has performed repentance actually...
All evil that man actually appropriates to himself remains.
In order that a man may actually enter Heaven he must actually present himself to the Lord, and since the Lord actually presents himself to man (in the Holy Supper) man actually receives Him...
Representations there are actual...
That evils actual and proper to man are those which torment in the other life.
Actual evil is also acquired by thoughts without act...
That Spirits do not go beyond the life which they have acquired by actuality.
1.2. Actuality mentioned.
Man should guard against any evil going into actuality; for as soon as there is actuality, it puts on custom and habit, and passes to posterity. See also
How necessary it is for man to abstain from actual evil.
The atmospheres... which are actuated in power by the sun.
Earths could not otherwise be actuated and produce forms of uses.
Waters and earths there... are actuated and modified by the heat and light of the spiritual sun.
The perfection of forces is the perfection of all things that are actuated and moved by life.
The substances contiguous to his body continually actuated by the heart and lungs...
The atmospheres in ultimates become such forces, by which the substances and matters, such as are in earths, are actuated into forms...
Forms of the mineral kingdom... actuated by the sun...
The Lord, by influx from Himself, actuates all things of the soul and of the mind, and actuates by an influx of love and wisdom.
The Divine life which by influx from the sun of Heaven actuates man...
The soul which actuates what is natural...
The spiritual world operates from within and actuates everything that exists in the world of nature.
That sometimes the evil have greater acumen.
Adah and Zillah
= a new Church which then arose.
Adah
= the mother of the celestial and spiritual things of that new Church;
Zillah
= the mother of its natural things.
(Parallel between Leah and Rachel, and Adah and Zillah.)
See also
Adam
supposed to mean the first man created.
By Adam in Paradise the Angels perceive the Most Ancient Church, not the Church [itself], but the faith in the Lord of that Church.
When the Most Ancient Church is called
Adam
it signifies that man was made out of the ground, or that man was made from non-man by regeneration... this is the origin of the name, and this is the signification of it.
The Hebrew word Adam signifies man
, and that Church is not properly called Adam, but Man. Explained.
Adam
is
ground.
Adam,
or
Man
= the Most Ancient Church.
General article.
There are two Hebrew words that signify man, Adam and Enosh; and by the man who is called
Adam
is understood the man of the Celestial Church; but by the man who is called
Enosh,
the man of the Spiritual Church.
By
Adam
or
Man
and Eve his wife is there understood a new Church.
Adam
was so called from the ground, for by him was signified the man of the Celestial Church, or the Church that is in good.
Man
or
Adam
and his wife = a Celestial Church.
Man
in Genesis = the Church itself, in like manner
ground,
from which
Adam
was named.

Some imagine that Adam was in such freedom that he could love God and be wise from himself... but this is an error... wherefore when he wished to be wise and to love from his own, he fell from wisdom and love, and was cast out of Paradise.
That the wisest of men, Adam and his wife, suffered themselves to be seduced. General article.
Adam and his wife do not mean the first men created in this world, but the men of the Most Ancient Church.
The state of innocence in which were Adam and Eve.
That hereditary evil is from Adam is an error. Explained.
The condemnation of Eve = the condemnation of their own voluntary, and the condemnation of Adam = the condemnation of their own intellectual.
The Most Ancient Church is described by Adam and Eve his wife.

They therefore are in enormous error who believe Adam to have been wise and to have done what is good from himself, and that this was his state of integrity; when yet Adam himself was cursed for that belief.
This was the sin of Adam. Explained.
It is said that the evil into which man is born is hereditarily from Adam, but it is from the parents... The reason why it is believed that the guilt of Adam is inscribed on all mankind...
Many have believed that Adam and Eve do not mean the first men created... (These passages show) that the earth was inhabited before Adam.
Adam
signifies the ground of the earth.
On the pre-adamites who were regenerated and called Adam.
They said that Adam could do what is good from himself.
Adam and Edom are both derived from red.
Hence Adam was so called from the ground.
On the Adamic or Most Ancient Church on this earth. General article.
Men
= things adapted.
All things there are adapted to the senses of Spirits and Angels; stone and wood are adapted to the senses of men in the body.
The Angels with the Lord... were adapted to the goods and truths then with Him.
That they may exactly correspond.
This memory is proper to a spirit and adapted to the state in which he is, for outward things are adapted to man... but inward things are adapted and correspond to a Spirit.
Adapted to their apprehension.
Adapted to the perception of the Angels.
Cannot be explained without adequate terms, and there are no terms better fitted (than these)... Nothing can be described without terms adapted to the subject.
A wise man is a recipient of Divine Love and Wisdom more adequately, thus more fully, than a simple man.
They are formed to receive adequately their own light.
The Divine Love and Wisdom are received by the Angels in a degree of heat and light adapted [to them].
Heat adapted to the love of Angels.
Words adapted to the ideas of my thought.
Thus by what is adapted and accommodated.
Adapts it to itself.
Correspondently and adaptedly.
The Lord thus adapts truths according to the reception of good...
Every true and suitable
scientific.
Signified,
Explained.
To hew or fit the stones = to hatch or invent things like truths from what is our own.
He is thus rendered fit
to receive the life of Heaven.
The incense brought within the veil = adaptation.
Divine truths are such that they can be adapted to what is good.
No conjunction of an active with a passive without adaptation or application.
Influx adapts itself to efflux.
Could the pure ether surround a man unless it thus adapted itself?
Not to add to give its strength to thee
= to be barren.
The human essence was only an additament to His Divine.
Joseph was named from gathering and adding.
To
add
= more.
Not to add
= no more.
Whatever man thinks, wills, speaks and does, adds itself to his life...
To
add anything to these words
= by adding anything that will destroy those truths.
To
add
is also a prophetic term meaning to destroy. Illustrated.
They who have been addicted to adulteries.
Hypocrites who have been saturated with evils through deceit.
Those who have been so much given up to self-love.
Concupiscences of evil with which they have been saturated.
Man is saturated with these two loves.
When these loves have been made habitual.
He had been saturated with the same dregs.
Good to which truth was adjoined. Signified.
The Lord willed thus completely to adjoin mankind to Himself.
That the human essence shall be adjoined to the Divine. Signified.
Thought from the human, that it was adjoined. Signified.
The Lord's thought from the human that has more closely adjoined itself to the Divine. Signified.
That the merit of righteousness was adjoined to the Divine Rational. Signified. To
place upon
= to adjoin.
Divine, to which rational human things were adjoined. Signified.
Truth Divine, that it was to be adjoined to the Divine good of the Lord's Rational. Treated of. See
Adjunction to His own life. Signified.
(Adjunction distinguished from conjunction.)
Adjunction of natural truth from another source. Signified. To be
weary of the life
= no adjunction, namely of natural truth to rational truth, for where there is not adjunction the rational appears to have no life.
Truths not learned in order to be done, adjoin themselves to affections of evil and falsity.
The adjunction of the affections of truth by good. Signified.
, Explained.
When a man adjoins these Societies to himself he is in evil, but when they are adjoined to him by the Lord he is in good.
The various kinds of Spirits that are adjoined to man when he is being regenerated.
To
adjoin
= conjunction.
The process of the adjunction of Societies of Spirits and Angels to man by the Lord.
To
go near
= adjunction.
To
pursue
= the disposition to adjoin, and to
overtake
= adjunction.
Mediate adjunction. Signified.
Thus Spirits who are like himself can always be called forth from Hell and adjoined to a man who is in evil.
Adjunction. Signified.
He adjoined to himself scientifics of the natural. Signified. To
go up with him
= to adjoin to himself.
To
join themselves to
= to reinforce.
To
call
= to adjoin.
To
take to
= to adjoin.
To
give to wife
= to adjoin.
And then simple good Spirits were adjoined to them... such Spirits are also adjoined to men in the world who are inwardly devils.
When the evil first come into the other life, they have good Spirits and Angels adjoined to them, as when they lived here. Explained.
Falsified truth is falsity not conjoined but adjoined to truth and ruling over it.
(The difference between appropriating falsity and adjoining it.)
Went up with them

= that were adjoined... Truths and goods not genuine remain adjoined at the side. So also the Lord's Church among the Gentiles, who have not genuine truths, are in Heaven adjoined to those who are in genuine truths and goods.
Good adopts truths and adjoins them to itself.
Good from the spiritual adjoined to truth when in combat. Signified, Explained... To
give to him for a woman
= to adjoin good to truth.

Spiritual good cannot be conjoined to those who are in the externals of the Church from infancy, but only adjoined so long as they are in combat... Such can only be reformed by the adjunction of spiritual good when they are in combat, but still they do not retain it.
The honour of any function is only adjoined to the person, and what is adjoined is separate from the person.
Why there are also Spirits who communicate with Hell adjoined to man.
Such Spirits are adjoined to man as he himself is as to affection; but good Spirits are adjoined by the Lord, and evil Spirits are summoned by the man himself.
The Spirits who are adjoined to man have nothing in common with natural order.
To every man there are adjoined Angels from heaven and Spirits from Hell.
From this it is evident that the Divine is not in man, but is adjoined to him.
All Spirits in the World of Spirits are adjoined to men. Explained.
The Angels notice that their conjunction with the Divine proceeding is of no other character than what may be called adjunction.
What is Divine cannot he appropriated to man as his, but it can be adjoined to him, and so appear as if it were his.
The Lord's presence with man is adjunction, thus conjunction by contiguity. Signified.
Divine truth is not united but adjoined to man; but the Divine of the Father is not adjoined, but united to the Lord's Human, as the soul to its own body.

There is not a conjunction into one (between married partners) but adjunction, near and close according to love, and (amounting) to contact with those who are in love truly conjugial; this adjunction may be called spiritual cohabitation.
Not that the Esse of God pre-exists, but because it enters the Essence as what is adjunctive cohering...
To this man there is adjoined an Angel from Heaven... to this, a Spirit from Hell adjoins himself...
Charity can be adjoined to a faith in three Persons, but never conjoined; and charity only adjoined to faith is merely natural, and is spurious.
His Divine Itself cannot be conjoined to man, but only adjoined; as light and sound cannot be conjoined to the eye and ear, but only adjoined to them... Life itself is adjoined to man, not conjoined.
To
adjure
= to bind by an oath, for adjuration is nothing but binding.
To
adjure
= most sacred binding, thus a solemn obligation
To
adjure
= to bind inwardly, here, to have at heart.
Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboim
= the falsities and evils in which they are terminated. Explained.
The kings of Admah, Zeboim
etc. = so many kinds of cupidities of evil and of persuasions of falsity.
Admah and Zeboim
= knowledges of what is evil and false.
The administration of rituals.
The outward man may be called the overseer or administrator of the house.
To
administer
= to discharge duties or employments.
The natural mind is what ministers and administers. Explained.
As Priests are governors to administer what is of Divine law and worship, so are Kings and Magistrates to administer what is of civil law and judgment.
There are many administrations in Heaven; ecclesiastical, civil and domestic.
The administrations of the Angels. Explained.
Honoured according to the dignity of the affairs he administers.
The person... is for the sake of the thing he administers, and not contrariwise.
The uses in the administration and discharge of which they are.
With us a priest administers betrothals.
The administrators in Heaven seen.
Although a kingdom is divided into a number of administrations
Taxes are collected for administration by officials etc.
The duties that belong to education and administration at home...
To introduce into a city a form of the administration of justice from judgment.
Occurs.
Bad and good administrators. Described.
See also
No one can be admitted into Heaven unless he has something of innocence in him. Signified.
Some have so gross an idea of Heaven as to suppose it to be mere admission, indeed that it is a chamber into which they are admitted by the door.
To be admitted into Heaven is of the Lord alone.
The Lord provides and disposes each and all things, but some from permission, some from admission, some from leave, etc.
They with whom this circumcision was rapidly represented in the World of Spirits wished to be admitted into Heaven, and before they were admitted, this was represented.
Therefore care is taken of the Lord's Providence that a man is not admitted into acknowledgement itself and faith of heart further than he can be kept in them.
No one can be admitted into the Lord's Kingdom, that is, into Heaven, unless he is in the good of love and of charity.

The preparation of the Divine Human to admit and support these temptations treated of... The Lord admitted temptations into Himself in order to expel thence all that was merely human... That the Lord admitted into Himself temptations...

Every one can he admitted into Heaven, because Heaven is denied by the Lord to none, but whether they can live there they can know if they are admitted. Some who had constantly believed this were also admitted, but... when they came there they began to be tortured...
But they are only admitted to the first entrance, that is, to those who are still simple...

Recently arrived Spirits have sometimes complained... that they are not admitted into Heaven, for they have had no other opinion concerning Heaven than of admission from grace; but it has sometimes been replied to them that Heaven is denied to none, and if they desire they will be admitted, some also were admitted into the heavenly Societies that were nearest to the entrance...
. See also
The dividing of the Jordan and their going through on dry ground signified the removal of evils and falsities and the admission of those who are in goods and truths.
He admitted into Himself all the Hells in their order...
Nor is any one admitted into Heaven unless he knows and believes these things...

A certain deceitful one... was admitted into a Society where were simple good, who in less than an hour began to lament that he had taken away from them the perception of good and truth... then somewhat of light from an interior Heaven was admitted, in which he appeared there like a devil...
The man of the Church... supposes that Heaven is only admission; but he is much mistaken, for no one can be admitted and received into Heaven unless he has received spiritual life...

The Societies to whom the cuticles correspond are in the entrance to Heaven; and to them there is given a perception of the quality of the Spirits who approach the first limit, whom they either reject or admit.

Man after death cannot be admitted into Heaven until he acknowledges in his heart that there is nothing of good and truth from himself, but from the Lord, and that whatever is from himself is nothing but evil.
Hence it is evident that... the spiritual cannot be admitted into Heaven except through Divine means...
That it is worship from the good of love that is received is because no one is admitted into Heaven, thus to the Lord, but he who is in good...
Wherefore a man is not admitted into temptations... before he is in a state of intelligence...
Those who have the idea of three Divines cannot be admitted into Heaven...
[Swedenborg footnote 1.] That no one is admitted into Heaven by merely thinking, but by at the same time willing and doing what is good.
No one can be admitted into Heaven who thinks of three gods.
The universal Heaven acknowledges the Lord alone, and he who does not acknowledge is not admitted into Heaven.
I have also seen these admitted into Heaven, but when they found there that they were without truths they were cast down...
Therefore they who deny the Lord's Divine cannot be admitted into Heaven, and be in the Lord.
It is also concluded from this natural state that salvation is only admission to the Angels in Heaven, and that admission is of immediate mercy...
Man can comprehend this with natural thought if he will only admit into it something of spiritual light.
On admission into an interior Heaven. General article.
They who are in mutual love in Heaven, continually advance towards the springtime of their youth...
These things represent the Lord from His first childhood even to adolescence.
On account of this end the Lord insinuates the delight which childhood and youth perceive in the sciences.

The celestial things which are of love are insinuated from first infancy even to childhood, and also to adolescence as man is then and afterwards imbued with sciences and knowledges. If the man is such that he can be regenerated, these sciences and knowledges are filled up with celestial things which are of love and charity, and thus are implanted in the celestial things with which he was gifted from infancy to childhood and adolescence, and thus his outward is conjoined to his inward man. They are first implanted in the celestial things with which he was gifted in adolescence, afterwards in those with which he was gifted in childhood, and at last in those with which he was gifted in infancy.
This treats of the Lord's first combat, which was in His childhood and first youth.
Afterwards a young girl flew to the right cheek.
Afterwards, when he grows up, little by little this good, innocence and peacefulness recede.
When he grows up he is imbued with truths.
Infants there grow up as they advance in intelligence and wisdom.
Affections of good and truth are called
infants,
girls,
young women
and
daughters,
but everywhere with a difference as to state...
young woman
= affection in which there is charity.
Young women playing with timbrels

= affections of truth. Young women are distinguished from virgins by means of innocence, virgins are so called from marriage love, thus those who are in innocence, for marriage love is innocence itself.
As man progresses from infancy and grows up and matures in judgment.

The Angels have no idea of the things of time, as the ages of man, namely infancy, childhood, youth, adult age and old age... Instead of the time of childhood and youth they have the idea of a state of affection of good and truth...
The boys (Esau and Jacob) grew up
= the first state, namely of conjunction of good and truth... To
grow up,

when predicated of good and truth, = the first state of progress... Good and truth... are conceived, are in the womb, are born, grow up, and advance in age even to the last one; their conception, gestation and birth belong to the state of arising; their growing up and advancing in age belong to the state of progress. The state of progress follows from the birth, and is a state of conjunction of good and truth. The first of this state is what is here signified by growing up. This state commences after birth and is continued to the end of life...
Sensual things are those in which children are, scientific things are those in which they are when they grow up.
This is the state of infancy and childhood as to the new life... but the state of its adolescence and youth
is...

elements.str: Spiritual food is knowledge, intelligence and wisdom... and by means of this food Spirits and Angels grow up.
Until Shelah my son grows up
= when it is time. To
grow up
= to be of that age, thus when it is time.

From childhood to adolescence there is opened communication to the interior natural through his learning what is decorous, civil and honest, also through instruction from parents and masters, and by means of studies. From adolescence to youthful age however, communication is opened between the natural and the rational, through his then learning truths and goods of civil and moral life...
Man from infancy up to childhood, and sometimes to the first adolescence, imbues goods and truths through instruction from parents and masters...
Into this state (of reformation) are introduced many who are in the Church from infancy up to adolescence, yet few are regenerated.
As soon as they come to the age of adolescence they suffer themselves to be carried away by the world.

When the age of childhood commences, he by degrees puts off the state of innocence, but is still kept in a state of charity through the affection of mutual charity towards his like, which state with many lasts up to adolescence, he is then among the spiritual Angels, afterwards, because he begins to think for himself...
When a man grows up, and begins to rule himself from himself...
When therefore a man betakes himself to evils, as takes place with most in adolescence.
As soon as he grows up and forms conclusions from sensual things to causes, thus begins to think from the interior natural... But when he becomes a youth, as he then matures... he forms reasons...

Man advances in the things of faith during his regeneration, almost as he does in the truths not of faith, while he is growing up. While he is growing up sensual things are the first plane, afterwards scientific things...

Those who are in the age of adolescence and early youth... believe the doctrinal matters of their Church to be real truths, and hence decide upon falsities, but are not able, as yet, to settle disagreements between those things that are matters of faith within the Church.

Those who are of the Spiritual Church, in their childhood, and afterwards in adolescence, have faith in the doctrinal matters of their own Church, but at that time they have faith from parents and masters.

Afterwards when man grows up and begins to think for himself, so far as he is then carried away by the delights of the love of self and of the world, so far this new voluntary or initiament of a new will is closed; but in so far as he is not carried away by these delights so far it is opened, and also perfected.
The third state is from the twentieth to the sixtieth year of age, which state is a state of intelligence, and is called adolescence, youth and manhood.
That infants grow up in the Heavens.

The Spirits are changed with man according to the changes of his affections, hence there are some Spirits with him in infancy, others in childhood, others in adolescence and youth, and others in old age... In adolescence and youth Spirits are present who are in affection of truth and of good, and thence in intelligence, thus who communicate with the Second or Middle Heaven.

That infants as they are perfected in intelligence and wisdom, appear more mature (in Heaven), thus as youths and young men and women, is because intelligence and wisdom are spiritual nourishment itself... Infants in Heaven do not advance in age beyond early youth...

The difficulty of resisting evils increases in proportion as a man does evils from the will... but this takes place with those who in mature age rush into evils without check, and at the same time reject Divine things from the heart.
